verdict.rationale: Vanta clearly has a public API, so this story applies, but nothing in the evidence pack documents API versioning or a deprecation policy. A changelog listing new endpoints is a related feature, not a versioning or deprecation commitment, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented API versioning scheme, published deprecation policy and timelines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
